400.description: Invalid argument - The client specified an invalid argument

401.description: Unauthenticated - The request does not have valid authentication credentials

403.description: Permission denied - The caller does not have permission to execute the specified operation

404.description: Not found - Some requested entity was not found

408.description: Deadline exceeded - The deadline expired before the operation could complete

409.description: Aborted - The operation was aborted due to concurrency issue

412.description: Failed precondition - Operation was rejected because the system is not in required state

413.description: Out of range - Operation was attempted past the valid range

429.description: Resource exhausted - Some resource has been exhausted (rate limiting)

431.description: Request header fields too large - Request metadata was too large

499.description: Cancelled - The operation was cancelled by the client

501.description: Unimplemented - The operation is not implemented or supported

503.description: Unavailable - The service is currently unavailable

504.description: Deadline exceeded - Upstream service did not respond in time

BetaManagedAgentsListSessionThreadEvents.description: Paginated list of events for a single thread within a `session`.

data.description: Events for the thread, ordered by `processed_at`.

next_page.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when no more results.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionEvent.description: Union type for all event types in a session.

BetaManagedAgentsUserMessageEvent.description: A user message event in the session conversation.

content.description: Array of content blocks comprising the user message.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the agent finished processing this message.

BetaManagedAgentsUserInterruptEvent.description: An interrupt event that pauses agent execution and returns control to the user.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the interrupt was processed.

session_thread_id.description: If absent, interrupts every non-archived thread in a multiagent session (or the primary alone in a single-agent session). If present, interrupts only the named thread.

BetaManagedAgentsUserToolConfirmationEve.description: A tool confirmation event that approves or denies a pending tool execution.

deny_message.description: Optional message providing context for a 'deny' decision. Only allowed when result is 'deny'.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the confirmation was processed.

session_thread_id.description: When set, the confirmation routes to this subagent's thread rather than the primary. Echo this from the `session_thread_id` on the `agent.tool_use` or `agent.mcp_tool_use` event that prompted the approval.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the `agent.tool_use` or `agent.mcp_tool_use` event this result corresponds to, which can be found in the last `session.status_idle` [event's](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/events/list#beta_managed_agents_session_requires_action.event_ids) `stop_reason.event_ids` field.

BetaManagedAgentsUserCustomToolResultEve.description: Event sent by the client providing the result of a custom tool execution.

content.description: The result content returned by the tool.

custom_tool_use_id.description: The id of the `agent.custom_tool_use` event this result corresponds to, which can be found in the last `session.status_idle` [event's](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/events/list#beta_managed_agents_session_requires_action.event_ids) `stop_reason.event_ids` field.

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution resulted in an error.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this result was processed.

session_thread_id.description: Routes this result to a subagent thread. Copy from the `agent.custom_tool_use` event's `session_thread_id`.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentCustomToolUseEvent.description: Event emitted when the agent calls a custom tool. The session goes idle until the client sends a `user.custom_tool_result` event with the result.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this tool use was processed.

session_thread_id.description: When set, this event was cross-posted from a subagent's thread to surface its custom tool use on the primary thread's stream. Empty on the thread's own events. Echo this on a `user.custom_tool_result` event to route the result back.

session_thread_id.description: When set, this event was cross-posted from a subagent's thread to surface its permission request on the primary thread's stream. Empty on the thread's own events. Echo this on a `user.tool_confirmation` event to route the approval back.

content.description: The result content returned by the tool.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadMessageRecei.description: Delivery event written to the target thread's input stream when an agent-to-agent message arrives.

from_agent_name.description: Name of the callable agent this message came from. Absent when received from the primary agent.

from_session_thread_id.description: Public `sthr_` ID of the thread that sent the message.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadMessageSentE.description: Observability event emitted to the sender's output stream when an agent-to-agent message is sent.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

to_agent_name.description: Name of the callable agent this message was sent to. Absent when sent to the primary agent.

to_session_thread_id.description: Public `sthr_` ID of the thread the message was sent to.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of status change.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusRunningEve.description: Indicates the session is actively running and the agent is working.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of status change.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusIdleEvent.description: Indicates the agent has paused and is awaiting user input.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of status change.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusTerminated.description: Indicates the session has terminated, either due to an error or completion.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of status change.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadCreatedEve.description: Emitted when a subagent is spawned as a new thread. Written to the parent thread's output stream so clients observing the session see child creation.

agent_name.description: Name of the callable agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the thread was created.

session_thread_id.description: Public `sthr_` ID of the newly created thread.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationSt.description: Emitted when an outcome evaluation cycle begins.

iteration.description: 0-indexed revision cycle. 0 is the first evaluation; 1 is the re-evaluation after the first revision; etc.

outcome_id.description: The `outc_` ID of the outcome being evaluated.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when outcome evaluation started.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationEn.description: Emitted when an outcome evaluation cycle completes. Carries the verdict and aggregate token usage. A verdict of `needs_revision` means another evaluation cycle follows; `satisfied`, `max_iterations_reached`, `failed`, or `interrupted` are terminal — no further evaluation cycles follow.

example.explanation: All five sections present with inline citations.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of the verdict. For `needs_revision`, describes which criteria failed and why.
examples: All five sections present with inline citations.

outcome_evaluation_start_id.description: The id of the corresponding `span.outcome_evaluation_start` event.

outcome_id.description: The `outc_` ID of the outcome being evaluated.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when outcome evaluation ended.

result.description: Evaluation verdict. 'satisfied': criteria met, session goes idle. 'needs_revision': criteria not met, another revision cycle follows. 'max_iterations_reached': evaluation budget exhausted with criteria still unmet — one final acknowledgment turn follows before the session goes idle, but no further evaluation runs. 'failed': grader determined the rubric does not apply to the deliverables. 'interrupted': user sent an interrupt while evaluation was in progress.

usage.description: Aggregate token usage for this evaluation cycle. Sums across all grader model requests within the cycle.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestStartEv.description: Emitted when a model request is initiated by the agent.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the model request started.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestEndEven.description: Emitted when a model request completes.

is_error.description: Whether the model request resulted in an error.

model_request_start_id.description: The id of the corresponding `span.model_request_start` event.

model_usage.description: Token usage for this model request.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the model request completed.

BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationOn.description: Periodic heartbeat emitted while an outcome evaluation cycle is in progress. Distinguishes 'evaluation is actively running' from 'evaluation is stuck' between the corresponding `span.outcome_evaluation_start` and `span.outcome_evaluation_end` events.

outcome_id.description: The `outc_` ID of the outcome being evaluated.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this heartbeat was emitted.

BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEvent.description: Echo of a `user.define_outcome` input event. Carries the server-generated `outcome_id` that subsequent `span.outcome_evaluation_*` events reference.

rubric.content: Must cover all five sections; cite sources inline.

description.description: What the agent should produce. Copied from the input event.

max_iterations.description: Evaluate-then-revise cycles before giving up. Default 3, max 20.

outcome_id.description: Server-generated `outc_` ID for this outcome. Referenced by `span.outcome_evaluation_*` events and the session's `outcome_evaluations` list.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the outcome was accepted.

rubric.description: How to grade the outcome. File rubrics are currently resolved to their text content; clients should handle both variants.

examples.content: Must cover all five sections; cite sources inline.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionDeletedEvent.description: Emitted when a session has been deleted. Terminates any active event stream — no further events will be emitted for this session.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the session was deleted.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRunn.description: A session thread has begun executing. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of the status transition.

session_thread_id.description: Public sthr_ ID of the thread that started running.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusIdle.description: A session thread has yielded and is awaiting input. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of the status transition.

session_thread_id.description: Public sthr_ ID of the thread that went idle.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusTerm.description: A session thread has terminated and will accept no further input. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of the status transition.

session_thread_id.description: Public sthr_ ID of the thread that terminated.

BetaManagedAgentsUserToolResultEvent.description: Event sent by the client providing the result of an agent-toolset tool execution. Only valid on `self_hosted` environments, where sandbox-routed tools are executed by the client rather than the server.

content.description: The result content returned by the tool.

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution resulted in an error.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this result was processed.

session_thread_id.description: Routes this result to a subagent thread. Copy from the `agent.tool_use` event's `session_thread_id`.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the `agent.tool_use` event this result corresponds to, which can be found in the last `session.status_idle` [event's](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/events/list#beta_managed_agents_session_requires_action.event_ids) `stop_reason.event_ids` field.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusResc.description: A session thread hit a transient error and is retrying automatically. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent the thread runs.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of the status transition.

session_thread_id.description: Public sthr_ ID of the thread that is retrying.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionUpdatedEvent.description: Emitted when an UpdateSession request changed at least one field. Carries only the fields that changed; absent fields were not part of the update. The new configuration applies from the next turn.

agent.description: The session's effective agent configuration after the update. Present only when the update changed `agent` (tools or mcp_servers); when present it is the full materialised snapshot, not a diff.

budget.description: The session's budget after the update: the new budget when set or replaced, or null when the update removed it. Present only when the update changed the budget.

metadata.description: The session's full metadata bag after the update. Present when the update set non-empty metadata; absent when metadata was unchanged or cleared to empty.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the update was applied.

title.description: The session's new title. Present only when the update changed it.

BetaManagedAgentsSystemMessageEvent.description: A mid-conversation system message event. Carries system-role content that is appended to the session as a `role: "system"` turn.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this system message was processed.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageEvent.description: Periodic snapshot of the session's cumulative usage and tracked list cost.

budget.description: The session's configured budget at the snapshot time, or null when the session has no budget.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was taken.

usage.description: The session's cumulative usage at the snapshot time.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionBudgetReached.description: The agent stopped because the session's tracked list cost reached its budget, or because its usage includes a model with no list price (which the budget cannot measure). Raise the budget to continue — or, if raising is rejected because a model has no list price, remove the budget.
